name: Form 31-E, Appointment of Executor
note: EXTRACTED from docs/23-inventory-act1.md (Act II items) by tools/extract-content.mjs. Do not edit: change doc 23 and re-run. E6. Signed by Hob; accepted by Sump; admits Thad to the archive (E9). Gone after Act IV opens: packed in his case (doc 121 N-5; errata 250).

LOOK_AT.say: Form 31-E, Appointment of Executor. Signed 'Hob', and nothing else. Mr. Sump will want a surname.
repeat: A very neat hand. Small, upright, and in no hurry at all.
It names my executor 'and his agent, as he shall appoint.' He has appointed me. I am, in law, my own estate's errand boy.
Nothing. It was signed by a man who says almost nothing, and it has taken after him.

lostNote: Packed (doc 121 N-5; errata 250): Act IV opens with his case packed on the bed (doc 57: "there was less to pack than there was to leave"), and a paper that is done with is in it. It leaves the inventory when ACT reaches 4.
